-- CUTOVER: historical lesson execution semantics remain legacy and unbound.
-- Stable identity backfill copies no mutable Course content or fictional revision.
ALTER TABLE student_learning_path_item ADD COLUMN id uuid;
UPDATE student_learning_path_item SET id=(substr(md5(student_learning_path_id::text || ':' || position::text),1,8)||'-'||substr(md5(student_learning_path_id::text || ':' || position::text),9,4)||'-5'||substr(md5(student_learning_path_id::text || ':' || position::text),14,3)||'-8'||substr(md5(student_learning_path_id::text || ':' || position::text),18,3)||'-'||substr(md5(student_learning_path_id::text || ':' || position::text),21,12))::uuid;
ALTER TABLE student_learning_path_item ALTER COLUMN id SET NOT NULL;
ALTER TABLE student_learning_path_item ADD CONSTRAINT student_learning_path_item_id_key UNIQUE(id);
ALTER TABLE student_learning_path_item ADD COLUMN lesson_revision_id uuid;
ALTER TABLE student_learning_path_item ADD COLUMN frozen_requirements jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb CHECK(jsonb_typeof(frozen_requirements)='array');
ALTER TABLE student_learning_path_item ADD COLUMN lesson_content_json jsonb;
DO $$ DECLARE n text; BEGIN
 FOR n IN SELECT conname FROM pg_constraint WHERE conrelid='student_learning_path_item'::regclass AND contype='u' AND array_length(conkey,1)=3 LOOP EXECUTE format('ALTER TABLE student_learning_path_item DROP CONSTRAINT %I',n); END LOOP;
END $$;
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX student_learning_path_item_legacy_reference_key ON student_learning_path_item(student_learning_path_id,reference_type,reference_id) WHERE lesson_revision_id IS NULL;
ALTER TABLE student_learning_path_item ADD CONSTRAINT lesson_assignment_shape CHECK ((lesson_revision_id IS NULL AND frozen_requirements='[]'::jsonb AND lesson_content_json IS NULL) OR (reference_type='lesson' AND lesson_revision_id IS NOT NULL AND jsonb_array_length(frozen_requirements)>0 AND jsonb_typeof(lesson_content_json)='object'));
CREATE TABLE student_lesson_activity_fact (
 source_type varchar(32) NOT NULL, fact_id uuid NOT NULL, student_id uuid NOT NULL,
 item_id uuid NOT NULL, requirement_id uuid NOT NULL, request_hash varchar(71) NOT NULL,
 occurred_at timestamptz NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(source_type,fact_id)
);
ALTER TABLE student_task_answer ADD COLUMN learning_path_item_id uuid;
ALTER TABLE student_task_answer ADD COLUMN requirement_id uuid;
ALTER TABLE student_task_answer ADD COLUMN frozen_task_json jsonb;
ALTER TABLE student_task_answer ADD CONSTRAINT answer_lesson_assignment_shape CHECK ((learning_path_item_id IS NULL AND requirement_id IS NULL AND frozen_task_json IS NULL) OR (learning_path_item_id IS NOT NULL AND requirement_id IS NOT NULL AND jsonb_typeof(frozen_task_json)='object'));
ALTER TABLE student_learning_action ADD COLUMN learning_path_item_id uuid;
ALTER TABLE student_learning_action ADD COLUMN requirement_id uuid;
ALTER TABLE student_learning_action ADD CONSTRAINT action_lesson_assignment_pair CHECK ((learning_path_item_id IS NULL)=(requirement_id IS NULL));
